exposure: immunotherapy during pregnancy and the postpartum period
outcome: course of neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorders (NMOSD)
cohort: The study included 112 women with neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD) who experienced 202 informative pregnancies.
finding: The postpartum period, particularly the first trimester, is a high-risk time for neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD) attacks and relapses, indicating that pregnancy detrimentally affects the disease course.
followup_time: At least through the first-trimester postpartum period.
